evidence_excerpts: The abstract reports equal-error 6x-60x faster for the unbiased estimator and 35x-65x faster for the biased estimator, with up to 3.4 million dynamic emissive triangles under 50 ms.
text: ReSTIR achieves substantially faster equal-error rendering than the compared state-of-the-art many-light method, including reported 6x-60x speedups for the unbiased estimator and 35x-65x for the biased estimator.
